evidence_atoms.title: Built an engineering practice

star.situation: The group was trying a shared approach to design reviews.
star.task: Help engineers learn from each other.
star.action: Personally designed the peer review format, hired the engineers and coached every engineer.
star.result: The engineering group adopted peer design reviews.

source_refs.excerpt: In February 2025 I hired and coached engineers while introducing peer design reviews. The engineering group adopted peer design reviews.

Jules sponsored the peer design-review pilot and coached three engineering managers. Engineers Mara Vale and Theo Reed designed the review format together. Hiring was shared with the managers. The engineering group adopted peer design reviews; we have not collected feedback about which coaching was most useful.

open_questions: What part of coaching was most useful to the engineers?

star.situation: The group wanted to reduce waiting for design reviews.
star.task: Understand the effect of the new review practice.
